answer: Proof of Stake acts as a secure vault for identity, requiring agents to bond assets as a relic of commitment. By locking capital to validate consensus, the mechanism ensures that spawning a nebula of fake identities imposes a prohibitive financial cost. An attacker must acquire and stake massive token quantities to gain voting power, rendering Sybil attacks economically irrational as the cost of capital outweighs any potential gain from network manipulation.
